name: Scene swap and re-voice
description: A real source clip (imported first) with the avatar swapped in by the Character Swap step (stage scene-video), then re-voiced and captioned. No prompt needed on the swap; the source drives everything. Set duration to the source's length (at most 30). Before saving, replace the change-voice step's voice_id with the avatar's voice_id from get_avatar.

slotBindings.source_video: <asset id of the imported source clip>
